updates.html: UX18 · Implementation & acceptance · 8 Nov 2026
Build the journey. Prove each transition.
Compose the existing shell, project readers, Executive owner and selected-session host. Source presence, installed availability and accepted outcomes remain separate.
REUSE EXISTING OWNERS
Five primary destinations
Today · Projects · Inbox · Conversations · Knowledge. Keep Search and advanced destinations accessible through the existing shell; do not expand the daily rail.
Project tabs: Conversation · Overview · Plan · Work · Evidence · Journal · More. These are app views; App.tsx icon paths are not URL routes.
App.tsx composes qualified slots. ProjectWorkspace renders them without creating reads, sends, pauses or persistence.
PRESERVE QUALIFICATION
One exact target per action
Resolve the current workRef and rootJobId through the existing catalogue. A transcript, role chart or project association does not qualify a Send target.
Use the independent Executive and selected-session hosts. Recheck principal, auth revision, binding generation, source and target before an effect.
Keep the mounted composer and unsent draft during Files or Project details. Owner change clears private content and invalidates cached authority.
PROVE THE PRODUCT
Source present · Proof pending
The 6 Nov candidate includes project create/open/Start work, goal and handoff, run history, completed-result follow-up and guarded native Send.
Configured capability, installed service, provider response, durable execution and product acceptance each need their own evidence.
Paper specifies composition and behavior. A screenshot, successful request, queued Job or completed run does not establish every later state.
1 · Create → Open → Start

Confirm project creation. Open project refreshes Programs and resolves the exact saved record. Planning stays available. Start work is separate: a current effect-free preview supplies profile, model, repo/base and attended/durable mode. Keep the original operation if the record is missing or ambiguous.
2 · Read → Draft → Send

Use incumbent source/result readers and exact owner + reference + revision. Add excerpt appends to the existing unaddressed draft: “Added to draft · Not sent.” Keep conditional Undo. Send appears only for the independently qualified selected session; a passive window never grants it.
3 · Run → Result → Follow-up

Keep execution, result, acknowledgement and acceptance separate. Read a result through its exact Job/Attempt association. An explicit follow-up creates one separately qualified successor run linked to validated completion; preserve the original root, input and evidence.
4 · Return → Access → Recover

Restore the owned selection, draft, scroll and focus. Recheck access before displaying private content. Unavailable capability is not permission denial. An uncertain create/send/start keeps its original operation and offers status lookup; never create a second effect to recover the first.
Extract the current composition

Today mobile N27-0 uses visible VNZ-0. Exclude REF ONLY groups N4N / N4T / PNJ / N58 / PM6 / N6Z from implementation. Bind review cards to the actual artifact title and revision; “Review recipients” opens recipient review without sharing.
Verify the installed journey

Prove create → exact open → preview → start; selected-session Send; source → draft → conditional Undo; Files/details return; original-effect recovery; completed-result follow-up. Check 320/390 px, keyboard, language, owner change and the exact installed build.
